profile.headline: Senior Software Engineering Manager @ Elastic
profile.summary:
I love learning new languages. When I was younger that meant Spanish and English, eventually Italian and French; my passion for languages naturally progressed into a career as a software engineer. 

I pride myself on my adaptability and versatility. I love the challenge of learning new technologies and pick them up quickly. Highly collaborative, I work well in groups as well as independently. I seek out projects that benefit from both my technical skills and my creative bent, and especially appreciate challenges that lead me to new areas of expertise.

projects.title: Ed-It
projects.description:
Role: Lead Engineer
Tech Stack: React, Redux, Node.js, Express, PostgreSQL

Single page classroom management app. Keep track of your classes, students, assignments, and outcomes. 

● Implemented front-end authentication using JWT to secure and validate user information
● Realized intuitive UX design allowing users to easily and quickly navigate from a view of their classes to the outcomes of a single student
● Managed front-end data flow using redux to minimize complexity and modularize code base

projects.title: My Ilera
projects.description:
Role: Full-Stack Software Engineer
Tech Stack: React, Redux, Node.js, Express, MySQL, Neo4j

My Ilera facilitates consumer-mediated health exchanges by giving patients control of their health information.

● Created a scalable architecture for front-end data-flow using redux to allow for a feature rich single-page app
● Facilitated easy and secure, real-time messaging between users using socket.io 
● Expanded server-side routing using Express creating a seamless user sign-up experience
● Integrated the Better Doctor API to authenticate providers and allow users to search for physicians
● Optimized app for mobile use using media queries, enhancing user experience
